signal: Kinective acquired Orbograph in 2026, adding AI fraud detection across its base of more than 4,000 financial institutions.

email.body1:
Dave, saw Kinective acquired Orbograph to add AI fraud detection across your base of 4,000-plus institutions.

A bigger product footprint usually means more mid-market accounts in play than the team can cover before deals cool, and that gap is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Kinective off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dave, quick follow-up for Kinective.

With Orbograph in the mix, the cross-sell and mid-market list grows faster than headcount can. Most leaders don't actually know how many meetings each rep needs to cover the new accounts, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Kinective needs to keep that mid-market funnel covered without hiring more reps.
email.body3:
Dave, last bit of proof for Kinective.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Kinective's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dave, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling mid-market coverage without adding reps isn't a priority while you integrate Orbograph, no problem at all. Post-acquisition quarters are their own kind of busy, and timing matters most here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your mid-market motion? I'll tailor it to Kinective either way.
